definitions.explanation: The original version of a creative work, especially a novel, manga, or other literary work that has been adapted into another medium such as film, anime, or drama.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{原作|げんさく}は{小説|しょうせつ}だ。
examples.english: The original work this movie is based on is a novel.

examples.japanese: {原作|げんさく}を{読|よ}んでからアニメを{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the anime after reading the original work.

examples.japanese: {原作|げんさく}とドラマではストーリーの{結末|けつまつ}が{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なっている。
examples.english: The ending of the story differs significantly between the original work and the TV drama.

notes:
Extremely common in discussions of adaptations — comparing manga to anime, novels to films, etc. {原作|げんさく}{者|しゃ} refers to the author of the original work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{原作|げんさく}を{読|よ}む — to read the original work
・{原作|げんさく}{者|しゃ} — the original author
・{原作|げんさく}に{忠実|ちゅうじつ} — faithful to the original
・{原作|げんさく}{通|どお}り — as in the original
・{原作|げんさく}ファン — fans of the original work
